publish, render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of, sign_in\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import create_post, post_url\nfrom tests.test_t03_president_control import act, president_for\nfrom tests.test_t05_pages import create_page, page_url\nfrom tests.test_t06_users import act as user_act, make_user\n\n\ndef live_post(editor, admin, title=\"Pitch: NVDA\", body=\"Body text\"):\n    url = post_url(create_post(editor, title=title, body=body))\n    act(admin, url, \"publish\")\n    return url\n\n\ndef live_page(admin, title=\"About\", body=\"We are KCFC.\", order=\"2\"):\n    url = page_url(create_page(admin, title, body, order))\n    act(admin, url, \"publish\")\n    return url\n\n\ndef render(client, tmp_path) -> Path:\n    return render_site(tmp_path / \"site\", client.app.state.database)\n\n\ndef test_only_published_items_are_written_under_their_own_paths(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Live Post\")\n    create_post(editor, title=\"Secret Draft\")\n    live_page(admin, \"About\")\n    create_page(admin, \"Hidden Page\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert (out / \"posts\" / \"live-post.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"about.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"posts\" / \"secret-draft.html\").exists()\n    assert not (out / \"hidden-page.html\").exists()\n    everything = \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\"))\n    assert \"Secret Draft\" not in everything and \"Hidden Page\" not in everything\n\n\ndef test_post_and_page_with_the_same_title_do_not_collide(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Join\", \"post body\")\n    live_page(admin, \"Join\", \"page body\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert \"post body\" in (out / \"posts\" / \"join.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"page body\" in (out / \"join.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_homepage_order_and_latest_posts(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_page(admin, \"Homepage\", \"Next meeting: Wed Oct 28, 7 pm, Oden 110\", \"1\")\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Older Post\")\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Newer Post\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    order = [html.index(s) for s in (\"Next meeting: Wed Oct 28\", \"financeclub@kenyon.edu\",\n                                      \"Newer Post\", \"Older Post\")]\n    assert order == sorted(order)\n\n\ndef test_navigation_lists_published_pages_in_order_plus_posts_listing(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_page(admin, \"Zeta\", order=\"1\")\n    live_page(admin, \"Alpha\", order=\"2\")\n    create_page(admin, \"Draftpage\", order=\"0\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert html.index(\"Zeta\") < html.index(\"Alpha\") < html.index(\"Posts\")\n    assert \"Draftpage\" not in html\n    assert 'href=\"zeta.html\"' in html and 'href=\"posts/index.html\"' in html\n\n\ndef test_posts_listing_is_newest_first_with_title_and_date(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"First Post\")\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Second Post\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert html.index(\"Second Post\") < html.index(\"First Post\")\n    assert re.search(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\", html)\n    assert 'href=\"first-post.html\"' in html  # relative to posts/\n\n\ndef test_byline_uses_display_name_never_email_and_pages_have_none(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Bylined\")\n    live_page(admin, \"About\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    post = (out / \"posts\" / \"bylined.html\").read_text()\n    assert re.search(r\"By Club Officer, \\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\", post)\n    assert \"@\" not in \"\".join(p.read_text() for p in out.rglob(\"*.html\")).replace(\n        \"financeclub@kenyon.edu\", \"\")\n    assert \"By \" not in (out / \"about.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_author_name_still_shows(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Old Post\")\n    user_act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"deactivate\")\n    assert \"By Club Officer\" in (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\" / \"old-post.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_president_creates_and_renames_display_name(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    token = csrf_of(admin, \"/admin/users\")\n    r = admin.post(\"/admin/users\", data={\"email\": \"kim@kenyon.edu\", \"role\": \"editor\",\n                   \"password\": \"first-pw-123\", \"display_name\": \"Kim Lee\",\n                   \"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 303 and \"Kim Lee\" in admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n    # a name is required\n    assert make_user(admin, email=\"noname@kenyon.edu\", display_name=\" \").status_code == 400\n    user_act(admin, \"kim@kenyon.edu\", \"name\", display_name=\"Kimberly Lee\")\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n    assert \"Kimberly Lee\" in page and \"Kim Lee<\" not in page\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_rename_users(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    token = csrf_of(editor, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    r = editor.post(\"/admin/users/1/name\", data={\"display_name\": \"X\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n                    follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_sanitizer_in_published_output(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    body = (\"# Heading\\n\\n- item\\n\\n[ok](https://example.com) [bad](javascript:alert(1))\\n\\n\"\n            \"<script>alert(1)</script><img src=x onerror=alert(1)><iframe src=x></iframe>\")\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Dirty\", body)\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\" / \"dirty.html\").read_text()\n    # raw HTML is shown as inert escaped text, so only live tags and links matter\n    for bad in (\"<script\", \"<iframe\", \"<img\", \"<a href=\\\"javascript\", \"href=\\\"javascript\"):\n        assert bad not in html\n    assert \"<h1>Heading</h1>\" in html and \"<li>item</li>\" in html\n    assert 'href=\"https://example.com\"' in html\n\n\ndef test_script_and_onerror_payloads_in_title_and_body_are_inert(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    title = \"Probe <script>window.__xss=1</script>\"\n    body = '<script>window.__xss=1</script>\\n\\n<img src=x onerror=\"window.__xss=2\">'\n    live_post(editor, admin, title, body)\n    published = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\").rglob(\"*.html\")\n    pane = editor.post(\"/admin/posts/preview\", data={\n        \"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf_of(editor, \"/admin/posts/new\")}).text\n    for html in [pane, *(f.read_text() for f in published)]:\n        assert \"<script\" not in html and \"<img\" not in html  # shown as escaped text instead\n\n\ndef test_no_root_absolute_paths_anywhere(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"P1\")\n    live_page(admin, \"Homepage\")\n    for f in render(editor, tmp_path).rglob(\"*.html\"):\n        text = f.read_text()\n        assert 'href=\"/' not in text and 'src=\"/' not in text, f\n    assert 'href=\"../style.css\"' in (tmp_path / \"site/posts/p1.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_unpublish_and_rerun_removes_the_item(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live_post(editor, admin, \"Gone Soon\")\n    assert (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\" / \"gone-soon.html\").exists()\n    act(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    out = render(editor, tmp_path)\n    assert not (out / \"posts\" / \"gone-soon.html\").exists()\n    assert \"Gone Soon\" not in (out / \"posts\" / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_pending_changes_banner_appears_and_clears_after_publish_run(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    assert \"Pending changes\" not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n    url = live_post(editor, admin, \"Banner Post\")\n    assert \"Pending changes\" in admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n    publish(tmp_path / \"site\", editor.app.state.database)\n    assert \"Pending changes\" not in admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n    act(admin, url, \"unpublish\")  # taking something down is a change too\n    assert \"Pending changes\" in admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\ndef test_root_absolute_links_in_markdown_are_dropped(client_as, tmp_path):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    live_post(editor, admin, \"Links\", \"[a](/about.html) [b](//evil.test/x) [c](page.html)\")\n    html = (render(editor, tmp_path) / \"posts\" / \"links.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = live_post(editor, admin, \"Clash\")\n    token = csrf_of(admin, url)\n    admin.post(url, data={\"title\": \"Clash\", \"body\": \"x\", \"slug\": \"index\", {"parentUuid":"3b293c9d-81e5-40b4-8d64-6b6729a43d53","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"file","filename":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_users.py","content":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_users.py","content":"\"\"\"T06: President-only User management. Seam 1: the HTTP app.\"\"\"\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, posts, users\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_of, sign_in\nfrom tests.test_t02_posts import create_post, post_url\nfrom tests.test_t03_president_control import president_for\n\n\ndef make_user(admin, email=\"new@kenyon.edu\", role=\"editor\", password=\"first-pw-123\",\n              display_name=\"New Person\"):\n    token = csrf_of(admin, \"/admin/users\")\n    return admin.post(\"/admin/users\", data={\"email\": email, \"role\": role,\n                                            \"password\": password, \"display_name\": display_name,\n                                            \"csrf_token\": token},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef find(admin, email):\n    conn = db.connect(admin.app.state.database)\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email,)).fetchone()\n    return row[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef act(admin, email, action, **extra):\n    uid = find(admin, email)\n    token = csrf_of(admin, \"/admin/users\")\n    return admin.post(f\"/admin/users/{uid}/{action}\",\n                      data={\"csrf_token\": token, **extra}, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef test_president_creates_a_user_with_a_hashed_first_password(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert make_user(admin).status_code == 303\n    assert \"new@kenyon.edu\" in admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n    conn = db.connect(admin.app.state.database)\n    stored = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE email = 'new@kenyon.edu'\"\n                          ).fetchone()[0]\n    assert stored.startswith(\"$argon2\") and \"first-pw-123\" not in stored\n    # signs in at once with the President-set password, no forced change\n    fresh = TestClient(admin.app)\n    assert sign_in(fresh, \"new@kenyon.edu\", \"first-pw-123\").status_code == 303\n    assert fresh.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_create_rejects_bad_input(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert make_user(admin, email=\"x@gmail.com\").status_code == 400\n    assert make_user(admin, email=\"a@b@kenyon.edu\").status_code == 400\n    assert make_user(admin, password=\"short\").status_code == 400\n    assert make_user(admin, role=\"root\").status_code == 400\n    assert make_user(admin).status_code == 303\n    assert make_user(admin).status_code == 400  # duplicate\n\n\ndef test_president_changes_a_role(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"role\", role=\"admin\").status_code == 303\n    conn = db.connect(admin.app.state.database)\n    assert users.get_user(conn, find(admin, \"editor@example.test\")).role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_user_cannot_sign_in_and_open_session_ends(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n    assert act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"deactivate\").status_code == 303\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303  # next action\n    fresh = TestClient(admin.app)\n    assert sign_in(fresh, \"editor@example.test\", \"test-editor-pw\").status_code != 303\n    assert fresh.get(\"/admin\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_president_reactivates(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"deactivate\")\n    assert act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"reactivate\").status_code == 303\n    fresh = TestClient(admin.app)\n    assert sign_in(fresh, \"editor@example.test\", \"test-editor-pw\").status_code == 303\n    assert fresh.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_there_is_no_delete_user_action(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    uid = find(admin, \"editor@example.test\")\n    token = csrf_of(admin, \"/admin/users\")\n    r = admin.post(f\"/admin/users/{uid}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": token},\n                   follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code in (404, 405)\n    r = admin.delete(f\"/admin/users/{uid}\", headers={\"x-csrf\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert r.status_code in (403, 404, 405)\n    assert \"/delete\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/users\").text\n    assert find(admin, \"editor@example.test\") == uid\n\n\ndef test_deactivated_users_posts_still_show_their_name(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = post_url(create_post(editor, title=\"Recap: alumni call\"))\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    act(admin, \"editor@example.test\", \"deactivate\")\n    conn = db.connect(admin.app.state.database)\n    post = posts.get_post(conn, int(url.rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1]))\n    assert post.author_email == \"editor@example.test\"\n    assert [p.author_email for p in posts.list_posts(conn)] == [\"editor@example.test\"]\n\n\ndef test_last_active_president_is_protected(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert act(admin, \"admin@example.test\", \"deactivate\").status_code == 400  # self + last\n    assert act(admin, \"admin@example.test\", \"role\", role=\"editor\").status_code == 400\n    conn = db.connect(admin.app.state.database)\n    me = users.get_user(conn, find(admin, \"admin@example.test\"))\n    assert me.active and me.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef test_president_cannot_deactivate_or_demote_self(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    make_user(admin, email=\"second@kenyon.edu\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert act(admin, \"admin@example.test\", \"deactivate\").status_code == 400\n    assert act(admin, \"admin@example.test\", \"role\", role=\"editor\").status_code == 400\n    other = TestClient(admin.app)\n    sign_in(other, \"second@kenyon.edu\", \"first-pw-123\")\n    assert act(other, \"admin@example.test\", \"deactivate\").status_code == 303\n    # second is now the last active President\n    assert act(other, \"second@kenyon.edu\", \"role\", role=\"editor\").status_code == 400\n\n\ndef test_officer_is_refused_everywhere(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert \"/admin/users\" not in editor.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert editor.get(\"/admin/users\").status_code == 403\n    token = csrf_of(editor, \"/admin\")\n    uid = find(editor, \"admin@example.test\")\n    for path, data in ((\"/admin/users\", {\"email\": \"z@kenyon.edu\", \"role\": \"admin\",\n                                         \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\"}),\n                       (f\"/admin/users/{uid}/role\", {\"role\": \"editor\"}),\n                       (f\"/admin/users/{uid}/deactivate\", {}),\n                       (f\"/admin/users/{uid}/reactivate\", {})):\n        r = editor.post(path, data={**data, \"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert r.status_code == 403, path\n    assert users.get_user(db.connect(editor.app.state.database), uid).active\n\n\ndef test_president_dashboard_links_to_users(client_as):\n    assert \"/admin/users\" in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n","numLines":147,"startLine":1,"totalLines":147}},"displayPath":"tests/test_t06_users.py"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"5657ba82-35f4-4be9-aada-572521aa7304","timestamp":"2026-10-15T05:01:27.213Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nCalled the Read tool with the following input: {\"file_path\":\"/Users/biswas1/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_users.py\"}\n</system-reminder>"},{"content":"<system-reminder>\nResult of calling the Read tool:\n1\t\"\"\"T06: President-only User management. Markdown body, Draft/Published status, author, immutable slug.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nDRAFT = \"draft\"\nPUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    author_name: str\n    created_at: float\n    updated_at: float\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT p.*, u.email AS author_email, u.display_name AS author_name\nFROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(row[\"id\"], row[\"title\"], row[\"slug\"], row[\"body\"], row[\"status\"],\n                row[\"author_id\"], row[\"author_email\"], row[\"author_name\"], row[\"created_at\"], row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\n# \"index\" would collide with the generated index.html / posts/index.html.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(title: str) -> str:\n    slug = re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or \"post\"\n    return slug + \"-1\" if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS else slug\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title)\n    slug, n = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        slug = f\"{base}-{n}\"\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n                now: float) -> int:\n    \"\"\"New Posts are always Drafts.\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, body, status, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_slug(conn, title), body, DRAFT, author_id, now, now),\n        )\n    return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef get_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> Post | None:\n    row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \" WHERE p.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_posts(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None,\n               status: str | None = None) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first. author_id limits the list to one User's Posts, status to one status.\"\"\"\n    clauses, args = [], []\n    if author_id is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.author_id = ?\")\n        args.append(author_id)\n    if status is not None:\n        clauses.append(\"p.status = ?\")\n        args.append(status)\n    where = \" WHERE \" + \" AND \".join(clauses) if clauses else \"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + where + \" ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC\",\n                        args).fetchall()\n    return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n\n\ndef count_by_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, author_id: int | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Posts per status (draft, published), optionally for one author.\"\"\"\n    sql, args = \"SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM posts\", ()\n    if author_id is not None:\n        sql, args = sql + \" WHERE author_id = ?\", (author_id,)\n    found = {r[\"status\"]: r[\"n\"] for r in conn.execute(sql + \" GROUP BY status\", args)}\n    return {DRAFT: found.get(DRAFT, 0), PUBLISHED: found.get(PUBLISHED, 0)}\n\n\ndef update_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                now: float, status: str, slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The slug changes only when a normalised `slug` is passed (Admin-only callers).\"\"\"\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, body = ?, status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" slug = COALESCE(?, slug) WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, body, status, now, slug, post_id),\n        )\n\n\ndef set_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int, status: str, now: float) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (status, now, post_id))\n\n\ndef slug_taken(conn: sqlite3.Connection, slug: str, post_id: int) -> bool:\n    return conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM posts WHERE slug = ? AND id != ?\",\n                        (slug, post_id)).fetchone() is not None\n\n\ndef delete_post(conn: sqlite3.Connection, post_id: int) -> None:\n    with conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", title=\"About\", body=\"We are KCFC.\", order=\"2\"):\n    token = csrf_of(c, \"/admin/pages/new\")\n    return c.post(\"/admin/pages\", data={\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"nav_order\": order,\n                                        \"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef page_url(response) -> str:\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    return admin.post(url, data={\"title\": \"About us\", \"body\": \"New\", \"nav_order\": \"5\",\n                          \"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    html = admin.get(url).text\n    assert \"About us\" in html and 'value=\"5\"' in html\n\n\ndef test_slug_is_generated_once_and_editable_by_president(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = pid).nav_order == 7\n    conn.close()\n\n\ndef test_president_publishes_unpublishes_and_deletes_with_confirms(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = page_url(create_page(admin))\n    assert \"Publish this?\" in admin.get(url + \"/publish\").text\n    assert \"Status: Draft\" in admin.get(url).text\n    assert act(admin, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"Status: Published\" in admin.get(url).text\n    assert \"Are you sure you want to unpublish this?\" in admin.get(url + \"/unpublish\").text\n    act(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    assert \"Status: Draft\" in admin.get(url).text\n    assert \"Are you sure\" in admin.get(url + \"/delete\").text\n    assert act(admin, url, \"delete\").status_code == 303\n    assert admin.get(url).status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_officer_is_refused_on_every_page_url_get_and_post(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    url = page_url(create_page(admin))\n    token = csrf_of(editor, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    for path in (\"/admin/pages\", \"/admin/pages/new\", url, url + \"/publish\",\n                 url + \"/unpublish\", url + \"/delete\"):\n        assert test_officer_sees_no_pages_link_or_pages_in_content_list(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    create_page(admin, title=\"Secret page\")\n    for path \"/admin/pages\" in admin.get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\ndef test_content_list_includes_pages_for_president_and_type_filter(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = president_for(editor)\n    create_page(admin, title=\"Leadership\")\n    editor_post = editor.post(\"/admin/posts\", data={\n        \"title\": \"A post\", \"body\": \"\", \"csrf_token\": csrf_of(editor, \"/admin/posts/new\")})\n    assert editor_post.status_code in (200, 303)\n    assert \"Leadership\" in admin.get(\"/admin/posts\").text\n    only_pages = admin.get(\"/admin/posts?type=page\").text\n    assert \"Leadership\" in only_pages and \"A post\" not in only_pages\n    only_posts = admin.get(\"/admin/posts?type=post\").text\n    assert \"A post\"  app = make_app()\n    for _ in range(2):\n        pages.seed_pages(app.state.database)\n    conn = db.connect(app.state.database)\n    found = [(p.title, p.status) for p in pages.list_pages(conn)]\n test_bad_navigation_order_is_rejected_not_coerced(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    for bad in (\"abc\", \"-3\"):\n        r = create_page(admin, order=bad)\n        assert r.status_code == 400 and \"whole number\" in r.text\n    assert \"About\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/posts?type=page\").text\n\n\ndef test_president_has_a_pages_link_officer_does_not(client_as):\n
